blocks.text: Minimal one-page website builder for landing pages and personal sites

Carrd strips website building down to its essentials. No bloated features, no complex menus - just a clean editor that helps you get a one-page site live in under an hour. For founders validating an idea, this speed matters more than any feature list.

The economics are hard to argue with. At $19/year for the Pro plan (which includes custom domains, forms, and analytics), Carrd costs less than a single month of most alternatives. When you are testing multiple landing pages for different market segments, that pricing model means you can experiment freely.

Carrd works best as a launchpad - the place where your idea first meets your audience. Once you have validated demand and need more sophisticated functionality, you can graduate to a full-featured builder. But many founders find that a well-crafted Carrd page converts just as well as anything more complex.
Purpose-built for single-page sites - landing pages, portfolios, link-in-bio
Built-in forms that connect to email services, Google Sheets, and webhooks
Sites adapt to every screen size automatically without manual breakpoint work
Connect your own domain with free SSL on Pro plans
Add payment buttons, videos, countdown timers, and third-party embeds
Dozens of starting templates organized by use case
When clients need to validate an idea before investing in a full build, we often point them to Carrd first. The speed and cost make it the perfect tool for testing market demand with minimal risk.
Our team can integrate Carrd into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
